interpretation: Mean judge counts are not consensus partitions or semantic validity. The nominal 95% task-bootstrap intervals are descriptive, pointwise, and unadjusted for multiplicity. The five primary counts also have 99% Bonferroni-style bootstrap intervals, an approximate family adjustment, not guaranteed coverage. First/second judgment means preassigned observation index, not chronological order or temporal drift. All first/second sensitivities are reported; none selects a winner. Quality, constraints, failure diagnostics, embeddings, and cost remain separate.
scope: Transcription of frozen estimates; cross-generator discussion is descriptive.
